body.summary: In eight eligible retained answers, Example was mentioned twice and its domain cited once. Verify the cited answer and investigate the comparison gap before editing pages.

context.goal: Help small teams evaluate Example's rank tracker.
assumptions: Fictional fixture; the audience and page roles are assumptions.

body.method: Read retained tracking samples and a saved synthetic report; no fresh research or page retrieval.

coverage.comparison: Not attempted; no comparable prior run was retained. No trend is established.

observations.fact: One complete answer cites the owned tracking guide; its factual accuracy is unverified.
One complete comparison answer has neither an Example mention nor an owned-domain citation.
The saved controlled test mentions Example without a citation; this is not consumer visibility.

recommendations.action: Verify the tracking guide's setup facts against the retained cited answer.
recommendations.question: How do I track weekly keyword rankings?
recommendations.facts_needed: Current setup steps and supported check frequency.
recommendations.benefit: Keep the already cited explanation accurate for prospective users.
recommendations.effort: Small manual review before proposing changes.
recommendations.uncertainty: Citation presence does not prove accuracy, traffic or recommendation quality.
recommendations.verification: Unexecuted: manually compare the guide and answer, recording any unsupported claim.

recommendations.action: Review whether the comparison page answers the small-team selection question.
recommendations.question: Which rank tracker fits a small team?
recommendations.facts_needed: Verified team features and evaluation criteria; page content has not been fetched.
recommendations.benefit: Identify a specific answer gap before commissioning comparison content.
recommendations.effort: Manual content review, then a scoped proposal if evidence warrants it.
recommendations.uncertainty: A single absent mention cannot diagnose the page or establish demand.
recommendations.verification: Unexecuted: inspect the relevant page section and document supported gaps.

recommendations.action: Propose a comparable retained-sample collection plan before claiming a visibility trend.
recommendations.question: Is Example earning more mentions over time?
recommendations.facts_needed: A prior run with identical revisions, locale, model and brand configuration.
recommendations.benefit: Avoid treating a synthetic mention as measured visibility improvement.
recommendations.effort: Review saved coverage and obtain separate approval for any new collection.
recommendations.uncertainty: No comparable baseline exists; future coverage and cost are unknown.
recommendations.verification: Unexecuted: require at least 90% complete coverage in both comparable periods.

body.deferred_alternative: Fresh paid research could expand coverage, but no spending was approved and retained evidence should be verified first.
